delivery_blocks.title: How delivery works
delivery_blocks.text: Orders are confirmed on WhatsApp, packed within one working day and delivered by our dispatch partners.

delivery_blocks.title: Returns and exchanges
delivery_blocks.text: If something does not fit, message us within 3 days of delivery. Items must be unworn with tags attached.

faq.q: How do I place an order?
faq.a: Add items to your cart, fill in your details and send the order on WhatsApp. We will confirm and arrange payment.

faq.q: Can I change my order after sending it?
faq.a: Yes, message us on WhatsApp as soon as possible and we will update it.

faq.q: How do I know my size?
faq.a: Use the Size guide link on each product, or message us and we will help.
